semantic_validator_rules.rule: The Test variable reference must resolve to a named Variable in the same Assessment.

Original OVAL variable_state/var_ref is a separate optional State predicate, not universally redundant. Native Test.variable may substitute it only when the source State variable identity is provably entailed by the selected Test variable for every compared Item. If absent in original source, preserve that absence; if nonredundant, reject automated lowering until an explicit native identity-State field is supported. This rule does not alter variable_state/value or var_check semantics.
